scan.title: Scan QR
scan.hint: Point the camera at the QR on the rack or locker.
scan.manualLabel: Type the code from the label
scan.recentEmpty: No scans on this device yet.
scan.permissionBody: You can still use a manual code or upload a photo of the QR.
scan.permissionChrome: In Chrome: tap the lock icon in the address bar → Site settings → Camera → Allow, then reload.
scan.permissionSafari: In Safari iOS: Settings → Safari → Camera → Ask/Allow, then reload.
scan.permissionFirefox: In Firefox: tap the camera icon in the address bar → Blocked → Allow.
scan.uploadHint: Pick a photo of the QR label from your gallery.
scan.notSupported: This browser cannot scan with the camera yet. Use a manual code.
scan.invalidCode: Unknown code. Check the label again.
scan.error: Camera failed to start. Try again or use a manual code.

history.title: My history

history.reverseBody: The original row stays. Undo creates a reversal row and restores stock.

opname.emptyVarianceBody: Variances from "Different" answers appear here for approval.
